t: Government of Malta publishes legal notices aimed at easing CoVid-19 restrictive measures
html:
Government of Malta has published the respective legal notices related to the easing of restrictive measures implemented to contain spread of CoVid-19 in Malta.

L.N. 170 of 2020 – Enforcement of the order relating to Closure of Non-Essential Retail Outlets and Outlets Providing Non-Essential Services (Amendment) Regulations, 2020 –

L.N. 171 of 2020 – Closure of Places Open to the Public (Amendment No. 2) Order, 2020 – 

L.N.172 of 2020 – Closure of Non-Essential Retail Outlets and Outlets Providing Non-essential Services (Amendment) Order, 2020 – 

L.N. 173 of 2020 – Number of Persons in Public Spaces (Increase in Number of Persons) Order, 2020 – 

L.N. 174 of 2020 – Enforcement of the order relating to the Number of Persons in Public Spaces Regulations (Amendment), 2020 – 

L.N. 175 of 2020 – Mandatory Non-essential Travel between Malta and Gozo (Revocation) Order, 2020 – 

L.N. 176 of 2020 – Epidemics and Infectious Disease (Suspension of Legal and Judicial times) (Amendment No. 2) Order, 2020 – 

L.N. 177 of 2020 – Closure of the Courts of Justice (Amendment No. 2) Order, 2020 –

L.N.178 of 2020 – Closure of Vehicles Roadworthiness Testing Stations (Revocation) Order, 2020 – 

Meanwhile it also published about the explaining the transition phase Mitigation measures .
